Sources.Title: Supported services
Sources.Intro: ModernTubeDownloader uses the active yt-dlp extractor set. Selected sources and features have additional, scoped MTD verification — not every site has been tested.
Sources.Loading: Reading the active yt-dlp extractor catalog…
Sources.CatalogFailed: The active yt-dlp catalog is unavailable. Check tool preparation or the custom executable in Settings, then reopen this window.
Sources.Popular: Popular — present in the active extractor set
Sources.TechnicalHint: CLI extractor names (IE_NAME) may differ from metadata extractor_key. Grouping does not imply identical capabilities.
Sources.GroupStatus: yt-dlp extractors: {0} • Scoped MTD verification: {1} • Marked broken: {2}
Sources.GenericHint: Generic extractors may recognize some direct streams and embedded players. This is not a guarantee for every website.
Sources.Broken: Upstream marks this extractor CURRENTLY BROKEN
Sources.YtDlpHint: Recognized by yt-dlp; ModernTubeDownloader has not fully validated all features of this source.
Sources.VerificationScoped: Real MTD verification applies only to these features and documented samples:
Sources.Scope.YouTubeAnalysis: Sintel metadata; public NASA live/replay analysis
Sources.Scope.YouTubeVod: Three bounded Sintel VOD sections, JSON, timestamp and History
Sources.Scope.TwitchCapture: Bounded FromNow, Stop and save, ffprobe A/V and short decode
Sources.Scope.TwitchRecovery: Controlled interruption, Parts, Partial and manual/automatic restart
Sources.Capability.LiveCapture: Bounded LIVE FromNow capture / Stop and save
Sources.CheckHint: Check a video, live stream or playlist URL. This only reads metadata and never adds a queue item or starts recording. Playlist checks preview at most 50 entries; opening Downloads reanalyzes the complete playlist.
Sources.Authentication: Authentication may be required. You can select a cookies.txt file in Settings; browser cookies are not extracted automatically.
Sources.CodecsUnknown: The returned formats have no codec identifiers. Direct video files may be selected in Auto/MKV and must pass a local audio/video probe after download. Explicit MP4/WebM compatibility and audio-only output cannot be promised.
Live.PageHint: Analyze a broadcast URL. Recording slots are separate from normal downloads.
Live.UseDownloads: This is a completed broadcast or ordinary video. Download it in Downloads.
Settings.LiveDescription: Independent recording slots; the app must run to monitor scheduled broadcasts.
Settings.PreserveLive: Preserve partial LIVE recordings after failure
Settings.AutoResumeLive: Automatically resume interrupted LIVE after restarting the app
Settings.PreserveLiveCancel: Preserve partial LIVE recording after manual cancellation

Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.Subtitle: Personalize downloads, appearance, and the managed tools.
Settings.GeneralDescription: Choose where files go and how new jobs are prepared.
Settings.ConcurrencyHint: Limits how many queue items may run at once. Lowering the value lets current jobs finish and delays new starts.
Settings.KeepTemporary: Keep temporary files after a successful merge
Settings.ToolsDescription: yt-dlp, FFmpeg, and the Deno JavaScript runtime are downloaded, verified, and updated automatically.
Settings.FfmpegDescription: Merges and validates audio and video streams
Settings.DenoDescription: Runs the JavaScript challenge solver required by current yt-dlp
Settings.BehaviorDescription: Control naming, conflicts, metadata, file dates, and thumbnails.
Settings.SetFileCreationTime: Set file creation date to media publish date
Settings.SaveMetadataSidecar: Save metadata JSON next to downloaded file
Settings.ResilienceDescription: Retries are in addition to the first attempt. Pacing is per item.
Settings.EnableInterDownloadDelay: Delay new queue starts (first item starts immediately)
Settings.ResumeInterruptedDownloads: Resume interrupted downloads when the source supports it
Settings.PreservePartialDownloads: Keep partial files after a failure
Settings.AutoResumeAfterRestart: Automatically resume interrupted jobs after restart
Settings.SubtitlesDescription: Default options for new downloads. Subtitles are off until you enable them.
Settings.SubtitlesEmbed: Embed subtitles in the video when supported
Settings.SponsorBlockDescription: Mark segments as chapters, or explicitly remove them. Off by default.
Settings.CookiesDescription: Choose a Netscape cookies.txt file exported by you; the app does not read browser databases.
Settings.CookiesHelp: Export cookies for the needed service with a trusted Netscape-format exporter, then select the local cookies.txt file here. Only the filename is shown; the path is saved locally.
Settings.CookiesWarning: This file may grant access to your account. Do not share it. Disable this option or delete the file when no longer needed.
Settings.CookieFile.Missing: The cookies file was not found. Select an existing cookies.txt file.
Settings.CookieFile.Unreadable: The cookies file could not be read. Check access and try again.
Settings.CookieFile.UnsupportedFormat: The file does not look like a supported Netscape cookies.txt file (maximum 32 MB).
Settings.SponsorBlockHint: MKV is required for Mark chapters. Remove is experimental and may have small cut/timestamp errors.
SponsorBlock.RemoveExperimentalWarning: Experimental: stream-copy removal can cause small cut or timestamp errors at joins.
Advanced.Title: Advanced download options
Advanced.LanguageCodesHint: Additional language codes, e.g. en, pl, en.*
Advanced.CookiesOn: Authentication: using the selected cookies file. Change it only in desktop Settings.
Advanced.CookiesOff: Authentication: cookies file is off. Change this only in desktop Settings.
Advanced.RangeConflict: Subtitles and SponsorBlock cannot be combined with a custom time range yet.
Advanced.RemoveSubtitleConflict: SponsorBlock removal cannot be combined with subtitles because timing could become incorrect.
Advanced.MarkRequiresMkv: SponsorBlock Mark creates incorrect MP4 chapters; WebM is unverified. Select explicit MKV, the supported container.
Range.KeyframeWarning: Without re-encoding, the cut may align to a nearby keyframe rather than the exact time.
Settings.AppearanceDescription: Changes apply immediately and are saved for the next launch.
Settings.BrowserIntegrationDescription: Extension links can launch the app and add media to the queue.
Settings.BrowserExtensionInfo: Browser extension: load the local browser-extension folder.
Settings.AdvancedDescription: Custom commands and tool locations for experienced users.
Settings.CustomArgumentsHint: Application-managed output, format, progress, print, and execution options cannot be overridden.
Settings.UseCustomYtDlp: Use a custom yt-dlp executable (automatic updates disabled)
Settings.UseCustomFfmpeg: Use a custom FFmpeg installation (automatic updates disabled)
Settings.UseCustomDeno: Use a custom Deno runtime (automatic updates disabled)
Settings.InvalidValue: Review the highlighted settings and try again.
Provisioning.Title: Preparing ModernTubeDownloader
Provisioning.Body: The download engine is being prepared. This happens automatically and may take a moment.
Provisioning.AttentionBody: Automatic preparation could not finish. Check your connection or choose custom tools in Settings.
Provisioning.ReadyBody: The download engine is installed and ready to use.
Details.Title: Title

Range.Label: Media range
Range.Error.Invalid: Enter time as hh:mm:ss (up to 30 days).
Range.Error.Required: Enter a start or end time.
Range.Error.Order: End must be later than start.
Range.Error.Duration: The range exceeds the media duration. For playlists, all selected entries must support the range.
Range.Error.ActiveLive: A custom range is not available for an active live stream.
Settings.RemoteDescription: Control the queue from another device on a trusted LAN. Off by default; HTTP is not encrypted.
Settings.RemoteAuthWarning: Any device on this local network will be able to control the queue.
Settings.RemoteRunning: Available at {0}. Enter the token shown above on the other device.
Settings.RemoteStopped: Stopped. Choose an active private LAN IP and save to make it available on your network.
Error.Generic: Something went wrong. Technical details were saved in the log.
Error.Download.Unknown: The download failed. Check the log for details and try again.
Error.Download.HttpForbidden: The service refused the download (HTTP 403 Forbidden). Retry after a moment if access should be available.
Error.Download.HttpNotFound: The requested media was not found (HTTP 404 Not Found). Check whether it is still available.
Error.Download.RateLimited: The service is limiting requests (HTTP 429 Too Many Requests). Try again later.
Error.Download.ServerError: The service reported a server error. Try again later.
Error.Download.Timeout: The connection timed out. Check your network and try again.
Error.Download.Network: The network connection was interrupted. Check your connection and try again.
Error.Download.LiveDisconnected: The LIVE recording was interrupted. Available data was kept; you can try to resume.
Error.Download.Private: This media or playlist is private. If your account has access, select a cookies.txt file in Settings.
Error.Download.Unavailable: This media is unavailable or has been removed.
Error.Download.Authentication: This media requires sign-in or age verification. Try selecting a cookies.txt file in Settings.
Error.Download.CookieProfileUnavailable: The selected browser profile was not found. Check its name in Settings.
Error.Download.CookieDatabaseLocked: yt-dlp could not read the browser cookie database. Close the browser or choose another profile, then retry.
Error.Download.CookieUnavailable: yt-dlp could not load cookies from this browser profile. Check access to the profile in Settings.
Error.Download.CookieFileMissing: The selected cookies file is missing. Choose it again in Settings.
Error.Download.CookieFileUnreadable: The selected cookies file cannot be read. Check its access in Settings.
Error.Download.CookieFileUnsupported: The selected file is not a supported Netscape cookies.txt file.
Error.Download.CookieFileRejected: yt-dlp rejected the selected cookies file. Export a fresh Netscape cookies.txt file.
Error.Download.Unsupported: This URL is not supported by the current download engine.
Error.Download.Format: The selected quality is no longer available. Analyze the media again or choose another quality.
Error.Download.Ffmpeg: The downloaded streams could not be merged or remuxed. Check FFmpeg and the log.
Error.Download.Disk: The output could not be saved. Check free space and folder permissions.
Error.Download.ActiveLive: This transmission is still live. Downloading active streams is not supported yet.
Error.Download.Upcoming: This transmission has not started yet.
Error.Download.ArchiveProcessing: The transmission has ended, but its replay is still being prepared. Try again later.
Error.Suggestion: You can retry the item or check the log if the problem persists.
